name: Tainted Scroll

angles.text: As a warlock, you meet Maximillion in Deathknell. He presents demonology and command of servants as a way to claim mastery and freedom.
As Forsaken, you share a dark parallel: breaking free of the Scourge and commanding demonic servants for your own survival.

faq.answer: The scroll bears Maximillion's personal seal. He is the warlock trainer in Deathknell and seeks newly awakened practitioners of the dark arts.
Maximillion trains newly raised Forsaken in Deathknell. He teaches them to summon and control demonic entities.
The scroll calls newly awakened warlocks to consider freedom, power, and servitude. It urges them to visit Maximillion for deeper instruction.
faq.q: What is written on the Tainted Scroll?

faq.answer: Maximillion says he is no traitor to Lady Sylvanas. He believes the Banshee Queen would understand his view, since she too pursued freedom from the Scourge.
faq.q: Is Maximillion a traitor to Lady Sylvanas?

faq.answer: You can find Maximillion in Deathknell, the ruined settlement in Tirisfal Glades where newly risen Forsaken first emerge from their graves.
The summons calls newly raised Forsaken warlocks to begin training with their local mentor in Deathknell.
faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?

sections.body: Newly risen Forsaken are clearing mindless Scourge remnants around Deathknell when a sealed scroll arrives. It bears the mark of Maximillion, the local warlock trainer. The message asks its recipient to consider servitude and freedom, then return to the ruined settlement and speak with him.
sections.title: A Dark Summons

sections.body: Maximillion teaches that escaping the Lich King's mindless grasp does not end slavery if another master holds the reins. A slave remains a slave until they claim true authority. He says mastering demonic servants does not betray Sylvanas. To Maximillion, it is the natural end of the Forsaken struggle for self-determination and respect.
sections.title: The Philosophy of Control

summary: In Deathknell, newly awakened Forsaken warlocks receive a summons bearing Maximillion's name. It calls them back to the ruined settlement to weigh freedom, power, and servitude.
